liabilities: Germ-cell/testicular expression; Shed antigen via GPI cleavage; Limited clinical program currently
cancer_relevance: Onco-testicular antigen re-expressed in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, mesothelioma, ovarian cancer, and germ-cell tumors. Bispecific ALPPL2 x CD89 reprograms macrophages preclinically; ALPPL2 also a biomarker target.

liabilities: Tumor-endothelial component creates vascular leak risk; Functional link to anthrax-toxin biology must be controlled; Limited clinical program currently
cancer_relevance: Surface receptor up-regulated on tumor vasculature and on triple-negative breast, neuroendocrine, and small-cell lung carcinoma cells. Anti-TEM8 mAbs and CAR-T explored preclinically.

liabilities: Normal myeloid/endothelial AXL expression; Plasticity of AXL+ EMT subpopulations; Soluble shed AXL sink
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in EMT / drug-resistance phenotypes across NSCLC, TNBC, AML, melanoma, and pancreatic cancer. Enapotamab vedotin (HuMax-AXL-ADC) and mecbotamab vedotin ADCs in trials; small-molecule bemcentinib also in development.

liabilities: GI expression (stomach, biliary tree) is a normal-tissue baseline; Hypoxic induction means CAIX can appear off-target in inflamed tissues; Heterogeneity within ccRCC tumors
cancer_relevance: Highly induced by VHL loss in ~95% of clear-cell renal cell carcinomas and broadly across hypoxic regions of multiple solid tumors; near-absent in normal kidney parenchyma. Validated PET imaging target (89Zr-girentuximab) and ongoing CAR-T / ADC programs.

liabilities: B-cell aplasia and hypogammaglobulinemia; CRS / ICANS; Antigen loss with isoform-skipping mutations
cancer_relevance: Pan-B-cell surface marker on essentially all B-ALL, most B-cell lymphomas, and CLL. Foundational target for CAR-T (tisagenlecleucel, axicabtagene, brexucabtagene, lisocabtagene), bispecifics (blinatumomab CD19xCD3), and a CD19 ADC (loncastuximab tesirine).

liabilities: Broad normal-tissue expression (neurons, endothelium); Immune-checkpoint axis -- need to assess effect on healthy immunity; Limited current clinical program
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on chronic lymphocytic leukemia, multiple myeloma, AML, and solid tumors (melanoma, ovarian); samalizumab (anti-CD200) was a clinical-stage program; preclinical CD200 CAR-T and bispecifics.

liabilities: Some normal expression on activated lymphocytes / vascular endothelium; Imperfect IHC standardization between sponsors; Heterogeneous spatial expression
cancer_relevance: Pan-cancer over-expression (NSCLC, prostate, breast, ovarian, pancreatic, melanoma, osteosarcoma, neuroblastoma, glioma) with relatively low normal-tissue surface expression. Multiple ADCs (ifinatamab deruxtecan, MGC018), CAR-T (especially pediatric solid tumors), and bispecifics in trials.

liabilities: Normal B-cell depletion / hypogammaglobulinemia; Antigen loss; Tetraspanin epitope-choice constraints
cancer_relevance: B-cell-lineage surface antigen on B-NHL (DLBCL, FL, MCL) and AML; naratuximab emtansine, 177Lu-lilotomab satetraxetan, BI 836826 antibody, and CD37-CAR-T are in trials.

liabilities: Ubiquitous low-level normal expression as complement regulator; Antigen sink potential; Hemolytic risk if complement regulation perturbed
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed on multiple myeloma plasma cells and on prostate and other solid tumors; FOR46 / MeM-102 ADC and CD46-targeting CAR-T in preclinical / early-clinical development.

liabilities: On-target effects on activated immune cells (CD27+); Antigen down-regulation under CAR-T pressure; Heterogeneous expression in RCC
cancer_relevance: Constitutively expressed on the surface of clear-cell RCC (>80% of cases), and on several B-cell and T-cell lymphomas, with tightly restricted normal expression (transiently activated lymphocytes and some dendritic cells). Multiple CAR-T and ADC programs (CTX-130, allogeneic; ARGX-110/cusatuzumab).

liabilities: Proteolytic processing complicates epitope choice; Heterogeneous expression; Limited normal-tissue toxicity profile defined
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in breast, ovarian, oral squamous, pancreatic, and lung carcinomas with roles in EMT, anoikis resistance, and metastasis. Indocyanine-green dual antibody co-targeting CDCP1 and mesothelin used for fluorescence-guided surgery in PDAC preclinical models.

liabilities: On-target normal intestinal expression (lateral membrane); requires liver-sparing or membrane-orientation-selective binders; Antigen heterogeneity in metastases; GI toxicity risk
cancer_relevance: Highly and lineage-restricted expression in colorectal (~95%), gastric, and pancreatic adenocarcinomas, as well as neuroendocrine tumors of GI origin, with normal expression confined to GI tract. Active CAR-T programs (PMIDs 35314826, 40435215) and ADC programs.

liabilities: Normal skin / mammary basal expression; Bidirectional adhesion biology; Limited current clinical program
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in basal-like breast cancer, pancreatic, gastric, ovarian, and endometrial cancers. PF-06671008 P-cadherin x CD3 bispecific and CDH3-targeting CAR-T explored.

liabilities: Some renal tubule and developmental expression; Deruxtecan-class ILD risk; Need for IHC patient enrichment
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in renal cell carcinoma (papillary subtype), ovarian cancer, cholangiocarcinoma, and thyroid. Raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd, anti-CDH6 ADC) under active investigation in ovarian and RCC.

liabilities: Soluble serum CEA acts as a sink; Cross-reactivity with CEACAM family on granulocytes / colon epithelium (engineered antibodies must discriminate); Heterogeneous staining intensity
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in colorectal (>90%), gastric, pancreatic, and a substantial fraction of NSCLC adenocarcinomas vs. restricted apical-only expression in normal colon. Active binder modalities: tusamitamab ravtansine ADC (NSCLC), CEA-TCB bispecific (cibisatamab), CAR-T.

liabilities: Nausea/vomiting from on-target gastric mucosa engagement; Loss of epitope availability if tight junctions re-form; Heterogeneous expression within and between tumor regions
cancer_relevance: CLDN18.2 (the gastric-isoform splice variant of CLDN18) is expressed in ~40-80% of gastric/GEJ adenocarcinomas and ~50-70% of pancreatic adenocarcinomas, with isoform expression restricted to normal gastric mucosa in adults. First-in-class mAb zolbetuximab approved (SPOTLIGHT/GLOW); ADC and CAR-T programs progressing.

protein_name: C-type lectin domain family 12 member A (CLL-1)
liabilities: Normal granulocyte / monocyte expression -> myelosuppression; CRS with bispecifics; Antigen loss reported in CAR-T resistance
cancer_relevance: Surface antigen on acute myeloid leukemia blasts and leukemic stem cells (LSCs) with sparing of normal HSCs; tepoditamab (CLEC12A x CD3), CLL-1 CAR-T (KITE-222), and CLL-1 / CD33 dual CAR-T in trials.

liabilities: HLA restriction (predominantly HLA-A*01:01); Heterogeneous expression; TCR-T cytokine-release risk
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen highly expressed in triple-negative breast cancer, gastric cancer, non-small-cell lung cancer, and cervical cancer. HLA-A*01:01-restricted TCR (Doran 2019) and follow-on NK/T-cell engagers in development.

liabilities: Requires HLA-A*02:01 (or other defined HLA) restriction -- limits eligible patients; Antigen heterogeneity within tumors; Risk of HLA loss as escape mechanism
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen expressed in 70-80% of synovial sarcoma, ~30% of myxoid liposarcoma, ~25-35% of melanoma, and subsets of NSCLC, ovarian, and esophageal cancer; expression in adult tissues restricted to germline. HLA-A*02:01-restricted peptides validated as TCR-T target (letetresgene autoleucel; precursor adoptive-T trials).

liabilities: Some adult adrenal and placental expression; Cleaved soluble form may act as sink; Pediatric exposure considerations
cancer_relevance: Oncofetal surface antigen re-expressed in neuroblastoma, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, small-cell lung cancer, ovarian, and adrenal cortical carcinoma. Targeted by ADCT-701 ADC in trials.

liabilities: CRS and ICANS with T-cell engagers; Lineage plasticity (NEUROD1/POU2F3 subtypes) drives DLL3 loss; Variable surface vs. intracellular pool
cancer_relevance: Expressed on the surface of >85% small cell lung cancers and high-grade neuroendocrine carcinomas, with negligible normal-tissue surface expression. Tarlatamab (DLL3 x CD3 BiTE) is FDA-approved; ADCs and CAR-T are advancing.

liabilities: Acneiform skin rash and diarrhea from on-target normal epithelial EGFR engagement; Hypomagnesemia; Acquired secondary mutations (C797S) under TKI pressure
cancer_relevance: Driver oncogene in EGFR-mutant NSCLC and over-expressed in colorectal, head-and-neck squamous, and squamous lung. Multiple binder modalities clinically validated (cetuximab, panitumumab, amivantamab EGFR/MET bispecific, antibody-drug conjugates).

liabilities: Normal basophil / mast-cell expression; Soluble released ectoenzyme; Modest dynamic range in ccRCC
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on the surface of clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, basophils/mast cells (CD203c marker), and a subset of papillary RCC. AGS-16C3F ADC was a clinical-stage RCC program.

liabilities: Basolateral expression on normal epithelium drives GI AEs; Antigen abundance leads to first-dose CRS for T-cell engagers; Imperfect tumor-vs-normal selectivity
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on essentially all epithelial carcinomas (CRC, gastric, prostate, breast, NSCLC) and on circulating tumor cells, with apical-only expression in most normal epithelia. Multiple bispecifics (catumaxomab, solitomab BiTE) and ADC programs.

liabilities: Some normal epithelial expression and homeostatic role in tissue boundaries; Bidirectional Eph/ephrin signalling complicates binder design
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed across many epithelial cancers (esophageal, gastric, lung, breast, ovarian, glioma) and drives migration / invasion. EPHA2-targeted CAR-T and bispecifics in preclinical and early-clinical development; MEDI-547 ADC historical.

liabilities: Endothelial / vascular expression; Forward-vs-reverse signalling complexity; Limited validated clinical binder
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed on Kaposi sarcoma, mesothelioma, head-and-neck, bladder, and prostate cancers; tumor-vascular component motivates anti-angiogenic / tumor-vasculature targeting.

liabilities: Cardiotoxicity from on-target cardiomyocyte HER2 inhibition; Intratumoral and HER2-low heterogeneity; Pneumonitis with deruxtecan payloads; Acquired loss / down-regulation under ADC pressure
cancer_relevance: Driver oncogene amplified/overexpressed in ~15-20% of breast cancers and ~10-20% of gastric/GEJ adenocarcinomas, with additional 'HER2-low' populations now therapeutically relevant; also expressed in subsets of NSCLC, biliary tract, colorectal, urothelial, and salivary cancers. Foundational antigen for binder modalities (trastuzumab, T-DM1, T-DXd, bispecifics, CAR-T).

liabilities: Interstitial lung disease with deruxtecan payload; Some expression on normal epithelia (skin, GI); Moderate dynamic range vs normal tissue
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed and a mediator of EGFR/HER2-TKI resistance in NSCLC, breast, head-and-neck, gastric, and CRC. Patritumab deruxtecan (HER3-DXd) is in pivotal development in EGFR-mutant NSCLC and HR+ breast cancer.

liabilities: Risk of bleeding via TF-FVIIa pathway perturbation; Ocular AEs with MMAE payload; Some expression on activated endothelium and monocytes
cancer_relevance: Aberrantly expressed in cervical, ovarian, esophageal, pancreatic, NSCLC, and head-and-neck cancers, with limited expression on normal epithelial surface. Tisotumab vedotin (TF-targeted MMAE ADC) is approved for previously treated recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer; further indications under study.

liabilities: Expression on wound-healing and fibrotic-tissue fibroblasts; Soluble FAP in plasma may act as a sink; Stromal target, so depth of penetration matters
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on the surface of activated cancer-associated fibroblasts in essentially all epithelial solid tumors (CRC, pancreatic, breast, NSCLC, gastric), with minimal expression in healthy adult tissues. Validated PET imaging target (FAPI tracers) and active CAR-T / bispecific / RPT programs.

protein_name: Glutamate carboxypeptidase II / Prostate-specific membrane antigen
liabilities: Salivary, lacrimal, kidney, and small-bowel expression drives xerostomia and renal sink; Loss of PSMA in dedifferentiated neuroendocrine prostate cancer; Heterogeneity within metastatic lesions
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in ~95% of prostate cancers, including castration-resistant disease, and on neovasculature of multiple solid tumors. Validated for radioligand therapy (177Lu-PSMA-617, VISION), PET imaging (68Ga-PSMA-11, 18F-DCFPyL), and emerging bispecific T-cell engagers.

liabilities: Renal/proximal-tubule FRalpha drives off-tumor uptake of folate-conjugates; Ocular AEs (keratopathy) with mirvetuximab; Expression heterogeneity demands diagnostic IHC
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (>35% of patients with high FRalpha), with significant expression in endometrial, NSCLC adenocarcinoma, and TNBC. Mirvetuximab soravtansine (ADC) is approved in FRalpha-high platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; multiple new FRalpha ADCs in trials.

liabilities: Wnt-pathway essentiality in intestinal stem cells creates on-target GI risk; Multiple Frizzled paralogs complicate selectivity; Mostly preclinical -- no clinical Frizzled-7 binder approved
cancer_relevance: Marks mammary tumor-initiating cells and is required for Wnt-driven proliferation in TNBC, gastric, and Wilms tumor models. Antibody disruption of Wnt signalling demonstrated in vivo preclinically.

liabilities: Cleaved soluble GPC3 sink; CAR-T cytokine release and on-target hepatic AEs in regenerating liver; Heterogeneity within HCC nodules
cancer_relevance: Onco-fetal antigen re-expressed in ~70-80% of hepatocellular carcinomas, with additional expression in subsets of squamous lung, Wilms tumor, and yolk-sac tumors. Adult normal liver does not express GPC3, giving a strong tumor-vs-normal contrast. Active CAR-T, bispecific, and ADC programs.

protein_name: G-protein coupled receptor family C group 5 member D
liabilities: On-target oral / dermal / nail toxicities from hard-keratinized-tissue expression; Antigen loss on retreatment (PMID 42108083); CRS / ICANS
cancer_relevance: Lineage-restricted surface receptor on malignant plasma cells in multiple myeloma; talquetamab (GPRC5DxCD3) is FDA-approved and used as a non-overlapping target to BCMA. Included as hematologic exemplar.

liabilities: GI toxicity if normal apical GUCY2C becomes accessible (e.g., mucosal damage); Antigen heterogeneity in metastasis; Bispecific CRS
cancer_relevance: Expressed in >95% of colorectal adenocarcinomas and in metastases (which lack the apical-sequestration of normal gut), with subsets in gastric, esophageal, and pancreatic. Bispecific T-cell engagers (e.g., PF-07062119) and CAR-T (PMID 39298141) are in clinical trials.

protein_name: Hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 1 (KIM-1 / TIM-1)
liabilities: Inducible expression in acute kidney injury -> off-target binding risk; Shed soluble KIM-1 sink; Limited normal expression tightly correlated with proximal-tubule damage
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on the surface of clear-cell renal cell carcinoma and a subset of ovarian clear-cell tumors with shed-ectodomain biomarker utility (urine KIM-1).

liabilities: Some macrophage/microglia expression in CNS tumor microenvironment; Antigen escape after CAR-T; CNS delivery constraints
cancer_relevance: Strongly over-expressed in ~75% of glioblastomas (highest among adult CNS tumors), with limited normal CNS expression. Active CAR-T programs (e.g., City of Hope locoregional CAR-T) and IL-13 cytokine toxin (cintredekin besudotox historically).

liabilities: Capillary-leak with tagraxofusp; Some normal HSC/basophil/endothelial expression; CRS with bispecifics
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN), AML LSCs, and a subset of ALL. Tagraxofusp (IL3-DT) is FDA-approved for BPDCN; multiple bispecifics (flotetuzumab, vibecotamab) and CAR-T (UCART123) in trials.

liabilities: Broad normal epithelial expression; Complex multi-subunit integrin biology; No clinical-stage anti-ITGA3 binder
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated on lung adenocarcinoma, gastric, pancreatic, and bladder carcinomas; functional driver of invasion. Preclinical antibody and CAR concepts explored.

liabilities: Wound-healing avb6 induction may produce off-tumor binding in inflamed tissues; Complex multi-subunit integrin biology; No approved binder yet
cancer_relevance: Alphavbeta6 is induced de novo on the surface of pancreatic, head-and-neck, lung, oral, cervical, and colorectal carcinomas (largely absent on normal adult epithelium). Active ADC and imaging programs; preclinical-stage CAR-T.

liabilities: CNS / peripheral nerve expression in adults; Cleaved soluble L1 sink; Heterogeneous expression in solid tumors
cancer_relevance: Re-expressed on the surface of neuroblastoma, glioma, ovarian, endometrial, and a subset of GI carcinomas; City of Hope L1CAM CAR-T (developed for neuroblastoma) and antibody-drug conjugates in clinical-stage exploration.

liabilities: Adult intestinal stem-cell expression -> on-target GI toxicity risk; Antigen heterogeneity; Conformation-dependent epitopes
cancer_relevance: Stem-cell marker over-expressed on a fraction of colorectal cancer (Wnt-high tumors), gastric, ovarian, and hepatocellular carcinomas. ADC and biparatopic concepts explored preclinically.

protein_name: Leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor subfamily B member 4
liabilities: Normal monocyte/dendritic-cell expression; AML lineage restriction -> off-target in non-monocytic subtypes; Antigen modulation
cancer_relevance: Surface marker of monocytic acute myeloid leukemia (M4/M5 AML) and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia with restricted normal expression on monocytes/tolerogenic DCs. IO-202 (anti-LILRB4) in phase-1 trials.

liabilities: Some normal lymphocyte and intestinal expression; Limited clinical program currently; Macrophage expression complicates tumor-cell vs immune-cell targeting
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in triple-negative breast cancer and identified as a theranostic target; drives lung metastasis via PD-L1-coupled transcription. ADC DLYE5953A explored clinically.

liabilities: Limited current clinical program after lupartumab discontinuation; Some normal-skin and esophageal expression
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in NSCLC, ESCC, and other carcinomas; pan-cancer analysis identifies LYPD3 as prognostic and as a candidate ADC target (lupartumab amadotin was a clinical-stage ADC).

liabilities: HLA restriction; Antigen heterogeneity; Need for high-affinity TCR engineering
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated across melanoma, NSCLC, ESCC, ovarian, and hematologic malignancies; TCR-T (TAEST16001) and TCR-mimic antibodies in preclinical/early-clinical development.

liabilities: Requires HLA-A*02:01 restriction; Antigen heterogeneity; Cytokine release with TCR-T
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen expressed in ~70-80% of synovial sarcoma, ~25% of myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma, and subsets of NSCLC, head-and-neck, esophageal, gastric, melanoma, and ovarian cancers. Afamitresgene autoleucel (afami-cel) is the first FDA-approved TCR-T therapy (synovial sarcoma).

liabilities: HLA restriction; Heterogeneous expression; Hypomethylation-dependent silencing on relapse
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated in melanoma, HCC, sarcoma, and other malignancies through DNA-hypomethylation; TCR-T and peptide-vaccine concepts.

liabilities: Retinal photoreceptor MERTK function (retinitis-pigmentosa biology) -> on-target ocular risk; Macrophage/efferocytosis expression; Limited clinical program
cancer_relevance: Aberrantly expressed on acute leukemia, glioblastoma, melanoma, and NSCLC tumor cells, and on tumor-promoting macrophages; preclinical CAR-T and bispecifics targeting MERTK described.

liabilities: Hepatic and GI on-target effects from normal hepatocyte MET; Peripheral edema with small-molecule MET inhibitors; Antigen heterogeneity between primary and metastatic sites
cancer_relevance: Amplification (~1-5% NSCLC), exon-14-skipping mutations (~3% NSCLC adeno), and protein over-expression define MET-addicted tumor subsets; also relevant in gastric, hepatocellular, and papillary renal cell carcinoma. Both small-molecule and antibody-based (telisotuzumab vedotin) ADC strategies are under active clinical development.

liabilities: Wound-healing / vascular MMP14 expression; Catalytic homology with other MT-MMPs requires selectivity engineering; Limited clinical program
cancer_relevance: Surface-bound metalloprotease over-expressed on invasive carcinomas (breast, pancreatic, head-and-neck), driving ECM degradation and metastasis. Active-site mAbs (DX-2400) and ADC concepts explored preclinically.

liabilities: Soluble shed mesothelin acts as a sink that blunts mAb/CAR potency; Capillary-leak and pleuritis with high-affinity binders; Pleural / pericardial normal expression poses on-target risk
cancer_relevance: Strongly over-expressed in mesothelioma (>85% of epithelioid), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (~80-90%), ovarian (~70%), and subsets of cholangiocarcinoma, NSCLC, and triple-negative breast cancer, vs. very limited normal mesothelial expression. Active modalities: immunotoxins (LMB-100), CAR-T, bispecifics, ADCs.

protein_name: Mucin-1 (MUC1-C / MUC1-CT cleavage product accessible on tumor surface)
liabilities: Soluble shed MUC1 sink; Wild-type MUC1 on normal epithelia means antibody specificity for tumor glycoforms is critical; Heterogeneous glycosylation
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed and aberrantly glycosylated in >90% of breast, ovarian, pancreatic, NSCLC, and CRC adenocarcinomas with neoepitopes not present on normal mucin. Active modalities: CAR-T (anti-Tn-MUC1 / 5E5), bispecifics, peptide vaccines (TG4010), MUC1-C small molecules.

liabilities: Skin (keratinocyte) Nectin-4 drives cutaneous AEs including TEN; Peripheral neuropathy / ocular AEs with MMAE payload; Down-regulation under EV pressure (acquired resistance)
cancer_relevance: Highly and lineage-restricted expression in urothelial carcinoma (>83% strongly positive in cohort series), with additional expression in subsets of breast, NSCLC, pancreatic, and head-and-neck cancers. Validated ADC target (enfortumab vedotin) approved for advanced urothelial carcinoma.

liabilities: Normal podocyte and endothelial expression; Glycosylation-dependent epitope choice; No approved binder
cancer_relevance: Cell-surface sialomucin marking aggressive renal, ovarian, pancreatic, and breast carcinomas; PODXL-high tumors are associated with poor prognosis. PR1A3 / 3D3 / PODOCAN antibodies described preclinically.

protein_name: Melanoma antigen preferentially expressed in tumors
liabilities: HLA restriction limits eligible patients; Cytokine release with bispecific TCR; Antigen heterogeneity within tumors
cancer_relevance: Over-expressed in cutaneous melanoma (~90%), uveal melanoma (~50%), and subsets of NSCLC, breast, ovarian, sarcoma, with germline-restricted normal expression. Brenetafusp (PRAME ImmTAC bispecific TCR) is in active trials; multiple TCR-T programs.

liabilities: Normal prostate / bladder / pancreas expression; Heterogeneous expression in PDAC; Antigen-loss escape with CAR-T
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in prostate cancer (>80% of high-grade), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, gastric and bladder cancers. Multiple CAR-T (CARMA, allogeneic gd-T BNT211 family) and bispecifics in preclinical / phase-1.

liabilities: Normal-tissue planar-cell-polarity expression; Heterogeneous tumor expression; ADC payload toxicities
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in TNBC, NSCLC, ovarian, and esophageal carcinomas. Cofetuzumab pelidotin (PF-06647020) and newer PTK7 ADCs are clinical / preclinical-stage.

protein_name: Inactive tyrosine-protein kinase transmembrane receptor ROR1
liabilities: Embryonic / developmental expression; Heterogeneity across hematologic and solid subsets; ADC ocular AEs
cancer_relevance: Onco-fetal surface receptor re-expressed in CLL, MCL, TNBC, ovarian, NSCLC, and pancreatic carcinomas with absent adult normal expression. Zilovertamab vedotin ADC (VLS-101) in clinical trials.

liabilities: CNS expression in normal neurons (BBB-protected but a consideration); Neuroendocrine plasticity may reduce SEZ6 in some SCLC subtypes; Calicheamicin / topo payload toxicities
cancer_relevance: Neuroendocrine-lineage surface antigen enriched in small-cell lung cancer; ABBV-011 / ABBV-706 anti-SEZ6 ADC in active development.

liabilities: Pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis biology -- on-target lung toxicity risk; ADC ocular AEs (XMT-1536); Heterogeneous expression in HGSOC
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and thyroid cancer with apically restricted normal-tissue expression. Lifastuzumab vedotin (DNIB0600A) and upifitamab rilsodotin (XMT-1536) are ADCs targeting NaPi2b.

liabilities: Limited normal-tissue profiling; No clinical-stage binder yet; Cleavage products may complicate ADC payload internalization
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in pancreatic adenocarcinoma where it remodels extracellular matrix and drives proliferation, migration, and invasion via PI3K/AKT; also a prognostic biomarker in colorectal cancer.

liabilities: Normal inner-ear / CNS expression; Heterogeneous expression in urothelial; ADC ocular AEs
cancer_relevance: Expressed on urothelial carcinoma and a fraction of NSCLC and glioma. Sirtratumab vedotin (ASG-15ME) ADC explored in urothelial cancer.

liabilities: Renal accumulation with peptide radioligand therapy; Lymphopenia / hematologic toxicity; SSTR loss in dedifferentiated NETs
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed on well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (carcinoid, pancreatic NETs), pituitary tumors, meningiomas, and a subset of SCLC/MTC. Validated radioligand-therapy target (177Lu-DOTATATE; Lutathera, NETTER-1/2) and PET imaging (68Ga-DOTATATE).

liabilities: HLA restriction limits patient eligibility; Antigen heterogeneity; Cross-reactivity to SSX1/SSX4 must be controlled
cancer_relevance: Cancer/testis antigen up-regulated in synovial sarcoma (chimeric SS18-SSX), melanoma, prostate, and HCC. Multiple HLA-A*02-restricted peptides characterized; TCR-T candidates preclinical.

liabilities: Some normal prostate, urothelial, and pancreatic expression; Complex six-transmembrane topology limits accessible epitopes; Heterogeneous expression in mCRPC
cancer_relevance: Highly expressed in prostate cancer (including mCRPC), with additional expression in Ewing sarcoma, bladder, and a subset of breast cancers. Lead programs: vandortuzumab vedotin (early), xaluritamig (STEAP1 x CD3 bispecific), CAR-T.

liabilities: Expression on normal epithelium (skin, GI) drives mucositis/skin AEs; Variable IHC dynamic range complicates patient selection; Interstitial lung disease with deruxtecan payloads
cancer_relevance: Broadly overexpressed across epithelial tumors -- TNBC, HR+/HER2- breast, NSCLC (adeno and squamous), urothelial, gastric, ovarian, head-and-neck -- relative to most normal epithelia. Validated ADC target (sacituzumab govitecan, datopotamab deruxtecan).

protein_name: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B (DR5)
liabilities: Hepatocellular DR5 expression -> on-target hepatotoxicity for high-avidity agonists; Death-receptor resistance mechanisms (FLIP, cIAP); Need for multivalent crosslinking
cancer_relevance: Death receptor surface-up-regulated on multiple carcinomas; second-generation hexavalent agonists (IGM-8444, eftozanermin alfa, BI 905711) re-engaged the target clinically after first-generation TRAIL biologics failed.

liabilities: Soluble shed BCMA sink; Antigen loss / down-regulation on relapse; Normal plasma-cell depletion (humoral immunity)
cancer_relevance: Lineage-restricted to plasma cells and uniformly expressed across multiple myeloma; included in this pan-cancer list as the canonical hematologic surface target informing solid-tumor binder design. Four FDA-approved binders span CAR-T (ide-cel, cilta-cel), bispecifics (teclistamab, elranatamab), and an ADC (belantamab mafodotin).

liabilities: Limited normal-tissue profiling; Tetraspanin biology requires careful epitope choice; Exosomal antigen sink potential
cancer_relevance: Up-regulated in colorectal, pancreatic, gastric, and hepatocellular carcinomas; drives metastasis and is enriched on tumor-derived exosomes. Anti-TSPAN8 mAbs explored preclinically.
